Math Notation Kit

Enables notation checks and adds theorem, proof, definition, and symbol snippets.

What it adds

  • Notation manager
  • Notation detection
  • Conflicting notation
  • Undefined notation
  • Snippet: Theorem environment
  • Snippet: Proof environment
  • Snippet: Definition environment

Tags

  • math
  • theorems
  • notation

Details

  • Version 1.0.0
  • By LatexDo
  • Identifier latexdo.math-notation-kit

Install Math Notation Kit

In LatexDo, open the Extensions view, find Math Notation Kit and choose Install. It is free.
